capability: Keep the committed primary output receipt when loose delivery or report projection is cancelled or fails after the primary commit (F07)
searchEvidence: The 1.1.12 roadmap allocation keeps the F07 output-truth repair; owner decisions 9 to 13 (2026-09-25 and 2026-09-26) keep WS-IO in 1.1.12 subject to its time box, and the commander scope decision in the WS-IO log limits it to F07.

Revalidated against v1.1.11: a cancellation of the loose delivery after the primary commit propagated as a run cancellation, and a cancelled or failed report projection dropped the committed output's path, size and SHA-256 from the presentation.
Existing owners are extended: CompositionRunService owns delivery and the run result; CompositionRunPresentationViewModel owns run-result projection. No second delivery or projection path is added.
semanticOwner: CompositionRunService remains the only delivery and run-result owner; CompositionRunPresentationViewModel remains the only run-result projection owner.
terminalContract: After the primary output commits, a cancelled loose delivery is recorded as a failed delivery with the committed primary receipt kept, without rerunning processors; a cancelled or failed report projection publishes the committed output's path, size and SHA-256 without a report. Cancellation before the primary commit and every output byte, name and range stay unchanged.

designReview.evidence: Bounded local R1 correction under ADR 0070; the commander's cross-runtime review of d4261e7ba is recorded in the WS-IO log and becomes the final review of the frozen head.
